program_name: ENGLISH CURRICULUM NAMES: 'Sustainable Engineering' and 'Product Engineering'. ITALIAN DIPLOMA NAME (what the degree certificate actually says): 'Ingegneria Chimica'. OFFICIAL ENGLISH NAME OF THE PARENT DEGREE: 'Chemical Engineering' - the Didactic Regulations Art. 1 give it explicitly: 'Corso di Studio Laurea Magistrale in Ingegneria Chimica (nome del corso in inglese: Chemical Engineering, classe LM-22 ...)'. THIS ITEM IS NOT A STANDALONE ENGLISH-TAUGHT DEGREE. It is a set of curricula inside an Italian-registered Laurea Magistrale, and the qualification awarded is the Italian degree in Ingegneria Chimica (class LM-22) regardless of which curriculum the student followed. *** CORRECTION TO THE RESEARCH BRIEF - THERE ARE TWO ENGLISH CURRICULA, NOT ONE. *** The brief describes a single 'Chemical Engineering (English curriculum)'. Every 2026/2027 official source says the degree has THREE curricula, TWO of which are delivered entirely in English: (1) 'Ingegneria di Processo' / 'Process Engineering' - in ITALIAN; (2) 'Sustainable Engineering' - in ENGLISH; (3) 'Product Engineering' - in ENGLISH. Didactic Regulations Art. 2: 'Il corso e organizzato in tre curricula (due dei quali erogati integralmente in lingua inglese)'. An English-speaking applicant therefore has a CHOICE OF TWO English tracks, and the two are substantively different: Sustainable Engineering is built on life-cycle thinking, industrial ecology, bioprocesses and renewable feedstocks; Product Engineering is built on a microscopic/structure-property approach to matter (rheology, soft matter, applied physical chemistry) aimed at pharmaceuticals, food, detergency, cosmetics and plastics. IDENTIFIERS: degree class LM-22; ministerial SUA identifier 'IdSua: 1573410' (Didactic Regulations Art. 1); official course code at Federico II M55 - the University course catalogue entry is published as 'M55 INGEGNERIA CHIMICA' at www.corsi.unina.it/M55. STRUCTURE: Laurea Magistrale (2-year second-cycle Master of Science), 2 years, 120 CFU/ECTS, no more than 12 examinations. School: Scuola Politecnica e delle Scienze di Base (SPSB). Department: Dipartimento di Ingegneria Chimica, dei Materiali e della Produzione Industriale (DICMaPI). PROGRAMME COORDINATOR: Prof. Almerinda Di Benedetto - she signs the department's international-applicant vademecum as 'Full Professor of Chemical Engineering, Coordinator of the BSc and MSc Programs in Chemical Engineering', and orientamento.unina.it lists her as 'Degree Programme Director' (tel. 081 768 2265, almerinda.dibenedetto@unina.it). Programme mailbox: infoingchim@unina.it. OPTIONAL ADD-ON: students may take a 'Percorso Minor' (Ingegneria Farmaceutica, Green Technologies, or Applied Machine Learning), worth roughly 24-32 CFU of which about 10 are extra-curricular; it requires an individual study plan and yields a mention in the Diploma Supplement plus a digital Open Badge.
level: master - Laurea Magistrale (2-year second-cycle Master of Science, 120 CFU/ECTS), class LM-22 Chemical Engineering. Not a single-cycle degree and not a first-level/second-level 'Master' in the Italian professional sense. Didactic Regulations Art. 9: 'La durata legale del Corso di Studio e di 2 anni ... Lo studente dovra acquisire 120 CFU' and 'La laurea si consegue dopo avere acquisito 120 CFU con il superamento degli esami, in numero non superiore a 12'. orientamento.unina.it classifies it under 'Master's Degree' with 'Degree required Laurea I Livello'; the University's International course catalogue lists it under 2-year Master's degrees (LM) > Engineering. Teaching runs in two semesters (first: late September to December; second: early March to mid-June), with at least seven examination sittings per course per year (five ordinary - January, February, June, July, September - plus two make-up sittings in March and between mid-October and mid-November). After the State Examination graduates may register with Section A of the Italian Order of Engineers.
teaching_language: PROGRAMME LEVEL: Italian AND English. orientamento.unina.it lists 'Language ENG/ITA' on the English profile and 'Lingua ITA/ENG' on the Italian one. The Didactic Regulations Art. 1 register the degree as 'lingua in cui si tiene il corso: italiano, inglese'. The University's International course catalogue lists the entry as 'Ingegneria Chimica / Chemical Engineering - IT/ENG' - contrast the fully English degrees in the same Engineering list, marked '- ENG' (Autonomous Vehicle Engineering, Data Science, Industrial Bioengineering, Transportation Engineering and Mobility). This IT/ENG registration matters for the non-EU Italian-B2 question - see language_requirements. CURRICULUM LEVEL - THE POINT OF THIS ITEM: of the three curricula, TWO are taught entirely in English and one in Italian. The department's own table (Vademecum LM 2025/26, section 1) is unambiguous: 'Ingegneria di Processo - Italiano; Product Engineering - Inglese; Sustainable Engineering - Inglese'. Didactic Regulations Art. 2: 'Il corso e organizzato in tre curricula (due dei quali erogati integralmente in lingua inglese)'. PRACTICAL CONSEQUENCE FOR AN INTERNATIONAL APPLICANT: an applicant who does not speak Italian must commit to Sustainable Engineering OR Product Engineering, and must select it explicitly on Segrepass at immatriculation. Choosing Ingegneria di Processo puts the student into Italian-taught classes. WHAT IS ACTUALLY IN ENGLISH INSIDE THE TWO CURRICULA (2025/2026 study plan). Product Engineering: Advanced Thermodynamics and Transport Phenomena (8 CFU), Safety in Chemical Processes (6), Applied Physical Chemistry (9), Rheology (9), Process Dynamics and Control (8), Chemical and Biochemical Reactors (8), Modeling and Numerical Simulation of Chemical Processes (6), Soft Matter Engineering (9), Unit Operations for Product Engineering (6), Structure Engineering (9). Sustainable Engineering: Advanced Thermodynamics and Transport Phenomena (8), Safety in Chemical Processes (6), Fermentation Chemistry and Industrial Microbiology (9), Process Dynamics and Control (8), Fundamentals of Bioprocess Engineering (6), Chemical and Biochemical Reactors (8), Sustainable Process Design (9), Environmental Chemical Engineering (6), Industrial Chemistry from renewable feedstocks (9), Structure Engineering (9). Both add 'Tirocini formativi e di orientamento' (6 CFU), 'Ulteriori conoscenze Linguistiche' (3 CFU), 'Prova finale' (15 CFU) and 18 CFU of free-choice courses. *** WARNING - THE 18 CFU OF FREE-CHOICE COURSES ARE NOT LANGUAGE-PROTECTED. *** The department states plainly, Vademecum LM 2025/26: 'la lingua di erogazione non costituisce un vincolo alla scelta' (the teaching language is not a constraint on the choice), and the published elective list mixes English titles (Interfacial engineering, Regenerative chemistry, Machine Learning for Product and Process Engineering, Environmental biotechnology, Food formulation engineering, Thermo-chemical conversion of biomass and waste, Sustainable technologies for pollution control, Biotechnological processes, Applied statistical thermodynamics, Heterogeneous photocatalytic processes, Industrial ecology and green engineering, Formulation chemistry and technology, Advanced numerical techniques for soft matter simulation) with ITALIAN ones (Biomateriali, Combustione e fluidodinamica di sistemi reagenti, Ingegneria dei materiali nanofasici per l'energia e la sensoristica, Ingegneria dei sistemi elettrochimici e celle a combustibile, Ingegneria Sanitaria Ambientale, Meccanica dei fluidi complessi, Reattori e apparecchiature multifase, Reti Neurali per Applicazioni Industriali, Rischi di esplosione nei luoghi di lavoro, Sicurezza di materiali solidi e liquidi ed attivita laboratoriali, Sicurezza strutturale antiincendio di edifici industriali, Simulazione molecolare di materiali). A non-Italian-speaking student must therefore pick their 18 CFU deliberately from the English-titled electives. Two named restrictions: 'Meccanica dei fluidi complessi' is not selectable by Product Engineering students (it overlaps with Rheology), and 'Advanced numerical techniques for soft matter simulation' requires 'Modeling and numerical simulation of chemical processes' as a prerequisite. THESIS - MANDATORY ENGLISH FOR THESE CURRICULA. Didactic Regulations Art. 16: 'L'elaborato deve necessariamente essere scritto e discusso in lingua inglese dagli studenti che scelgono uno dei due curricula in inglese. In tal caso deve essere comunque allegato un estratto in lingua italiana.' So the thesis and its defence MUST be in English, but an Italian-language abstract must still be attached. NOTE ON ITALIAN: no Italian-language teaching requirement is imposed by the programme for the two English curricula, but the degree is administratively an Italian/English degree, and much of the department's own web material, the study-plan forms, the vademecums (all published only in Italian), the didactic calendar and the student secretariat operate in Italian. [uncertain] I did not find a per-course language field published on unina.it confirming, course sheet by course sheet, that every Sustainable Engineering / Product Engineering course is delivered in English; the English-medium claim rests on the Didactic Regulations, the orientamento profile and the department's own curriculum/language table, which state it for the curricula as a whole.

degree_class: LM-22 - Ingegneria Chimica / Chemical Engineering. Stated on the Didactic Regulations cover ('LAUREA MAGISTRALE IN INGEGNERIA CHIMICA - CLASSE LM-22'), in Art. 1 ('classe LM-22'), on the orientamento.unina.it profiles ('Degree class LM-22' / 'Classe di laurea LM-22') and on the DICMaPI programme page ('Course class: LM-22 Chemical Engineering'). NEITHER ENGLISH CURRICULUM HAS ITS OWN DEGREE CLASS - Sustainable Engineering and Product Engineering are both LM-22, exactly like the Italian Ingegneria di Processo curriculum. There is no separate class, no separate SUA record and no separate degree title for the English tracks.
admission_type: OPEN ACCESS (accesso libero / non a numero programmato), CONDITIONAL ON TWO CHECKS PLUS A LANGUAGE CHECK. There is no ranking, no competitive selection, no bando/call, no quota and no scored entrance examination. orientamento.unina.it summarises the access mode in one line: English profile 'Admission: Verifica di preparazione'; Italian profile 'Accesso: Verifica di preparazione'; entry qualification 'Degree required: Laurea I Livello' / 'Titolo di ingresso: Laurea I Livello'. WHAT IS ACTUALLY CHECKED, in order (Didactic Regulations Artt. 4-5, and the department's Vademecum LM 2025/26 section 3): (1) CURRICULAR REQUIREMENTS - a documentary check of the applicant's bachelor transcript against a minimum of 54 CFU distributed over four blocks of scientific-disciplinary sectors (SSD). Carried out by the CCD, in practice through a 'Commissione Istruttoria'. (2) ADEQUACY OF PERSONAL PREPARATION - automatic if the applicant has at least 40 CFU in the four core chemical-engineering sectors AND a weighted bachelor average of at least 24/30; otherwise a colloquium or test. (3) LANGUAGE COMPETENCE - B1 in the language of the chosen curriculum, i.e. B1 ENGLISH for Sustainable Engineering and Product Engineering. CONFIRMED NOT RESTRICTED-ACCESS: the University's official 'Corsi a numero programmato' list for a.y. 2026/2027 does not contain Ingegneria Chimica or any LM-22. The only restricted-access two-year Lauree Magistrali on that list are Precision Livestock Farming, Professioni sanitarie, Psicologia Clinica e degli interventi nei contesti sociali e dello sviluppo, Scienze Enologiche and Scienze della Nutrizione Umana. The Scuola Politecnica e delle Scienze di Base states the same rule generally for its master's degrees: admission requires 'la verifica del possesso dei requisiti curriculari nonche la verifica della personale preparazione dello studente'. NO TOLC, NO SAT, NO GRE/GMAT, NO NATIONAL TEST. TOLC-I applies only to Federico II BACHELOR programmes in Engineering (the department publishes a separate 'Guida al TOLC-I per Ingegneria Chimica - 2026/2027' for the L-9 bachelor); it has no role in this master's. CURRICULUM CHOICE IS NOT A SELECTION. Entering Sustainable Engineering or Product Engineering is not competitive and has no separate quota; it is a declaration made by the student. Vademecum LM 2025/26: 'La scelta deve essere effettuata al momento dell'immatricolazione tramite il portale Segrepass.' (See uncertainty_notes for a timing discrepancy with the programme's Study Plan page, which says the curriculum is declared in the study plan by 31 October.) IF THE CURRICULAR REQUIREMENTS ARE NOT MET, ENROLMENT IS REFUSED UNTIL THEY ARE MADE UP. Didactic Regulations Art. 5: 'L'iscrizione al Corso di Laurea Magistrale non e consentita in difetto dei requisiti minimi curriculari sopra riportati. Se i requisiti minimi non sono soddisfatti, la CCD stabilisce le integrazioni curriculari che lo studente dovra effettuare anteriormente alla iscrizione ... mediante iscrizione a singoli corsi di insegnamento attivati dall'Ateneo ... e superamento dei relativi esami di profitto.' Note the word 'anteriormente' - unlike some Federico II engineering master's degrees, there is NO option here to enrol first and fill the gap later with an individual alignment study plan. The credits must be earned BEFORE enrolment, through 'corsi singoli' (http://www.unina.it/-/5601348-iscrizione-ai-corsi-singoli), which can cost a semester or more. FOR NON-EU APPLICANTS RESIDING ABROAD an additional national procedure sits on top: compulsory pre-enrolment on the Universitaly portal, then a study visa. That is a visa procedure, not a selection - see application_deadline_non_eu. FOR INTERNATIONAL APPLICANTS THE DEPARTMENT RUNS ITS OWN DOCUMENT-SCREENING STEP by email to infoingchim@unina.it before any of this - see required_documents.
academic_requirements:
ENTRY QUALIFICATION. A Laurea (Italian three-year bachelor), or a three-year university diploma, or a foreign qualification recognised as equivalent. Didactic Regulations Art. 4: 'Per l'iscrizione ad un corso di Laurea Magistrale e necessario essere in possesso di una Laurea o un diploma universitario di durata triennale, o altro titolo acquisito all'estero e riconosciuto idoneo. E previsto, inoltre, il possesso di specifici requisiti curriculari e la verifica obbligatoria dell'adeguatezza della personale preparazione dello studente. Quest'ultima include il possesso di adeguate competenze linguistiche.' orientamento.unina.it lists the entry title as 'Laurea I Livello'. 

CURRICULAR REQUIREMENT - AT LEAST 54 CFU/ECTS, IN FOUR SEPARATE BLOCKS. There is no automatic-access degree class here: EVERY applicant, Italian or foreign, is measured against the same 54-CFU grid. Didactic Regulations Art. 4: 'Il requisito curriculare richiesto per l'iscrizione al corso di Laurea Magistrale in Ingegneria Chimica consiste nell'avere conseguito almeno 54 CFU in settori scientifico-disciplinari specifici, articolati come segue'. The four blocks are cumulative minima, so a transcript strong in one block cannot compensate for a shortfall in another. 
(A) AT LEAST 15 CFU in mathematics / statistics / computing sectors: MATH-02/A (ex MAT/02) Algebra; MATH-02/B (ex MAT/03) Geometria; MATH-03/A (ex MAT/05) Analisi Matematica; MATH-03/B (ex MAT/06) Probabilita e Statistica Matematica; MATH-04/A (ex MAT/07) Fisica Matematica; MATH-05/A (ex MAT/08) Analisi Numerica; MATH-06/A (ex MAT/09) Ricerca Operativa; STAT-01/A (ex SECS-S/01) Statistica; STAT-01/B (ex SECS-S/02) Statistica per la Ricerca Sperimentale e Tecnologica; IINF-05/A (ex ING-INF/05) Sistemi di Elaborazione delle Informazioni; INFO-01/A (ex INF/01) Informatica. 
(B) AT LEAST 9 CFU in physics sectors: PHYS-01/A (ex FIS/01/04) Fisica Sperimentale delle Interazioni Fondamentali e Applicazioni; PHYS-03/A (ex FIS/01/03) Fisica Sperimentale della Materia e Applicazioni; PHYS-04/A (ex FIS/02/03) Fisica Teorica della Materia, Modelli, Metodi Matematici e Applicazioni. 
(C) AT LEAST 12 CFU in chemistry sectors: CHEM-03/A (ex CHIM/03) Chimica Generale e Inorganica; CHEM-04/A (ex CHIM/04) Chimica Industriale; CHEM-05/A (ex CHIM/06) Chimica Organica; CHEM-06/A (ex CHIM/07) Fondamenti Chimici delle Tecnologie. 
(D) AT LEAST 18 CFU in the four CORE CHEMICAL-ENGINEERING sectors: ICHI-01/B (ex ING-IND/24) Principi di Ingegneria Chimica; ICHI-02/A (ex ING-IND/25) Impianti Chimici; ICHI-01/C (ex ING-IND/26) Teoria dello Sviluppo dei Processi Chimici; ICHI-02/B (ex ING-IND/27) Chimica Industriale e Tecnologica. THIS 18-CFU CORE IS THE USUAL STICKING POINT FOR FOREIGN APPLICANTS, and the same four sectors reappear at a 40-CFU threshold in the personal-preparation test below. 

EQUIVALENCE. The transcript is read course by course, not just totalled, and the committee may map foreign courses onto these sectors. Didactic Regulations Art. 4: 'L'accertamento dei requisiti curriculari e effettuato dalla CCD, eventualmente avvalendosi di un'apposita commissione istruttoria, mediante analisi della carriera pregressa dello studente. La CCD potra individuare, motivandole, eventuali equivalenze di crediti di settori scientifico disciplinari differenti da quelli sopra previsti, sulla base dei contenuti di specifici insegnamenti presenti nella carriera pregressa dello studente.' Vademecum LM 2025/26: 'La Commissione ha facolta di riconoscere equivalenze tra crediti conseguiti in SSD differenti da quelli previsti, qualora i contenuti degli insegnamenti siano ritenuti coerenti con il percorso magistrale.' 

SHORTFALL - MUST BE FIXED BEFORE ENROLMENT. Vademecum LM 2025/26: 'Integrazioni Curriculari: Qualora i requisiti minimi non siano soddisfatti, l'immatricolazione diretta non e consentita. Lo studente dovra colmare il debito formativo iscrivendosi a singoli corsi di insegnamento attivati dall'Ateneo e superando i relativi esami di profitto prima di perfezionare l'iscrizione.' 

PERSONAL-PREPARATION REQUIREMENT - A THREE-WAY TEST KEYED TO THE ICHI SECTORS. Didactic Regulations Art. 5 sets two routes, and the department's Vademecum LM 2025/26 tabulates them: 
- 40 CFU OR MORE in ICHI-01/B, ICHI-02/A, ICHI-01/C, ICHI-02/B (typically a bachelor in Chemical Engineering or a closely related field) AND weighted average M >= 24/30 -> 'Adeguatezza automatica (nessun colloquio)'. M is 'la media M pesata (sulla base delle consistenze in CFU) delle votazioni (in trentesimi) conseguite negli esami di profitto necessari per il conseguimento del titolo che da accesso al Corso di Laurea Magistrale'. 
- 40 CFU OR MORE in those sectors but M < 24 -> 'Colloquio/Test sulle discipline ICHI'. 
- FEWER THAN 40 CFU in those sectors, whatever the average -> 'Colloquio/Test obbligatorio'. Didactic Regulations Art. 5: 'Gli studenti che nella propria carriera pregressa hanno acquisito meno di 40 CFU nei settori sopra citati (ex ING-IND/24-27) saranno sottoposti alla verifica dell'adeguatezza della personale preparazione ... indipendentemente dal valore di M.' 
NOTE THE GAP BETWEEN 18 AND 40: an applicant can clear the 18-CFU curricular minimum in block (D) and still be well short of the 40-CFU threshold, in which case the interview is compulsory no matter how good the grades are. A chemical-engineering bachelor normally clears both; a general chemistry, materials, mechanical, environmental or biotechnology bachelor usually does not. 

[uncertain] No published rule explains how a foreign grading scale is converted to the Italian /30 scale for the M >= 24 test; in practice this is decided by the committee when it reads the transcript. 

LANGUAGE IS PART OF THE ACADEMIC CHECK, at B1 in the language of the chosen curriculum - see language_requirements. 

NOTHING ELSE IS REQUIRED BY REGULATION. No GRE/GMAT, no portfolio, no research proposal, no minimum work experience. Reference letters are not required (and, unlike some other Federico II engineering departments, are not even listed as optional in this department's international vademecum). A CV is required by the department's international-applicant procedure - see required_documents. 

NO ADDITIONAL ACADEMIC REQUIREMENT FOR THE ENGLISH CURRICULA. The entry gate is the same LM-22 gate for all three curricula; only the language of the B1 check differs. The curriculum itself is chosen afterwards by the student.
entry_exam_or_test:
THERE IS NO SCORED, SCHEDULED, COMPETITIVE ENTRANCE EXAM. No TOLC, no SAT, no GRE/GMAT, no national test, no published test calendar, no question bank, no pass mark, no ranking. What exists instead are TWO CONDITIONAL, INDIVIDUALLY ARRANGED CHECKS, both triggered only for applicants who fail to clear an automatic threshold. 

(1) SUBJECT COLLOQUIUM OR TEST ON THE CORE CHEMICAL-ENGINEERING SECTORS. Triggered when the applicant has fewer than 40 CFU in ICHI-01/B, ICHI-02/A, ICHI-01/C, ICHI-02/B (ex ING-IND/24-27), OR has at least 40 CFU there but a weighted bachelor average below 24/30. Didactic Regulations Art. 5: 'tali studenti dovranno sostenere un test di ammissione o un colloquio finalizzato alla verifica della adeguatezza della loro personale preparazione con riferimento alle discipline proprie dei settori sopra citati. Informazioni relative alle modalita di svolgimento e superamento del suddetto colloquio o test saranno fornite agli studenti all'atto della prevalutazione della carriera pregressa.' 
SCOPE OF THE COLLOQUIUM IS NARROW AND PREDICTABLE - this is the single most useful preparation fact published. Vademecum LM 2025/26: 'Il colloquio vertera sugli argomenti dell'esame tra quelli dei settori ICHI superato con il voto piu basso. A parita di voto, si fara riferimento all'esame sostenuto cronologicamente per primo nel percorso formativo.' In other words the interview is on the topics of the ONE core chemical-engineering course you passed with your LOWEST grade (ties broken by whichever came first chronologically) - not on the whole syllabus. 
TIMING AND BOOKING. Vademecum LM 2025/26: 'Il colloquio potra essere sostenuto solo dopo l'avvio dell'immatricolazione. Il Coordinatore del CdS contattera gli studenti interessati per concordare la data.' So it is arranged individually by the Programme Coordinator (Prof. Almerinda Di Benedetto, infoingchim@unina.it) after the enrolment process has been started - there is no sitting to book in advance and no fixed dates. 
NO PUBLISHED PASS MARK, NO PUBLISHED RETAKE LIMIT. Unlike the mechanical-engineering master's at the same university, this programme publishes no score threshold, no number of attempts, no minimum interval between attempts and no question bank. 

(2) LANGUAGE PROFICIENCY TEST ('test di idoneita'). A separate check, triggered only when the applicant cannot document B1 in the language of the chosen curriculum. For the two ENGLISH curricula, Didactic Regulations Art. 5: 'Per l'ammissione ai curricula in lingua inglese, gli studenti in possesso di un titolo di studio ottenuto a seguito della frequenza di un corso di studio erogato in una lingua diversa dall'inglese, in assenza di certificazioni o idoneita linguistiche relative alla conoscenza della lingua inglese almeno a livello B1 del Quadro Comune Europeo di Riferimento (QCER), dovranno dimostrare, in un test di idoneita, di possedere adeguate capacita di comprensione e conversazione in inglese.' The Vademecum LM 2025/26 spells out how this lands on different applicants: 'Studenti laureati in Italia: E richiesto il possesso dell'idoneita B1 (es. esame "Inglese 2" in triennale) o il superamento di un test presso il CLA. Solo per A.A. 2025/2026: In alternativa al test/certificazione, e possibile sostenere un breve colloquio non tecnico in lingua inglese con la Commissione Istruttoria. Studenti con titolo estero: In assenza di certificazioni B1 e se il percorso precedente non era in inglese, e necessario sostenere un test di idoneita.' 
Note the short non-technical English conversation with the Commissione Istruttoria is explicitly flagged 'Solo per A.A. 2025/2026' - it is a one-year concession and should not be assumed to carry over. 

(3) NOT AN ENTRANCE EXAM, BUT OFTEN CONFUSED WITH ONE: the CLA B2 English placement test / 24-hour B2 course. That is the route to the 3 CFU of 'Ulteriori conoscenze linguistiche' needed to GRADUATE, not to be admitted. See language_requirements. 

(4) FOR INTERNATIONAL APPLICANTS the department adds a documentary screening followed by a possible interview. VADEMECUM FOR INTERNATIONAL STUDENTS: 'After the initial check, you may be contacted for an interview or further steps.' 

[uncertain] Nothing published states whether the subject colloquium or the language test can be sat remotely from abroad, in what language the subject colloquium is conducted for a candidate entering an English curriculum, or what happens if a candidate fails. Given that the colloquium can only be taken 'dopo l'avvio dell'immatricolazione' while non-EU candidates must complete Universitaly pre-enrolment by 15 June 2026, the sequencing for a non-EU applicant with a sub-24 average or fewer than 40 ICHI CFU is genuinely unclear and must be settled with the Coordinator in writing.
seats_total: NO SEAT CAP - the programme is open access. No number of places is published anywhere on unina.it for this degree, because none exists: the University's official 'Corsi a numero programmato' list for a.y. 2026/2027 does not include Ingegneria Chimica or any LM-22, and orientamento.unina.it records access as 'Verifica di preparazione' rather than a competition. Anyone who clears the curricular check (54 CFU), the personal-preparation check and the B1 language check may enrol. Consequently there is no ranking list (graduatoria) and no bando fixing places. NO CAP ON THE ENGLISH CURRICULA EITHER: neither Sustainable Engineering nor Product Engineering has a published maximum number of students; entry to them is by selection on Segrepass at immatriculation, not by allocation. [uncertain] Class-size limits could in principle be applied administratively (e.g. laboratory capacity), but nothing of the kind is published for this programme.
non_eu_reserved_seats: NONE - no seats are reserved for, or capped for, non-EU applicants. Reserved non-EU quotas at Federico II exist only for restricted-access (numero programmato) programmes, and this programme is not one of them (verified against the University's 'Corsi a numero programmato' 2026/2027 list, which contains no LM-22 and, among two-year master's degrees, only Precision Livestock Farming, Professioni sanitarie, Psicologia Clinica e degli interventi nei contesti sociali e dello sviluppo, Scienze Enologiche and Scienze della Nutrizione Umana). Non-EU applicants residing abroad still have to go through the compulsory Universitaly pre-enrolment and study-visa procedure, but that is a visa pipeline with a hard DATE (15 June 2026), not a NUMBER of places - see application_deadline_non_eu. Non-EU applicants who are already legally resident in Italy or in an EU country are treated exactly like EU applicants: international.unina.it, 'Non-European candidates, wherever they reside and regularly residing in Italy or in a European Union country, have unrestricted access to university courses if they hold a qualification corresponding to the required Italian qualification ... You will therefore not need to pre-register on the Universitaly Portal.'
language_requirements:
[uncertain] FOUR SEPARATE LANGUAGE RULES OPERATE AND THEY ARE NOT ALIGNED. Rules 1 and 2 are the programme's own and are well documented; Rule 3 is a stale departmental page that contradicts Rule 1; Rule 4 is the university/ministry rule that can actually derail a non-EU applicant. 

RULE 1 - PROGRAMME LEVEL, FOR ADMISSION TO THE ENGLISH CURRICULA: ENGLISH AT B1. NOT B2. This is the operative admission rule and it is unusually low. Didactic Regulations Art. 5, verbatim: 'Per l'ammissione ai curricula in lingua inglese, gli studenti in possesso di un titolo di studio ottenuto a seguito della frequenza di un corso di studio erogato in una lingua diversa dall'inglese, in assenza di certificazioni o idoneita linguistiche relative alla conoscenza della lingua inglese almeno a livello B1 del Quadro Comune Europeo di Riferimento (QCER), dovranno dimostrare, in un test di idoneita, di possedere adeguate capacita di comprensione e conversazione in inglese.' Practical effect: a bachelor's degree delivered in English satisfies the rule outright with no certificate at all; otherwise a B1 certificate; otherwise a proficiency test. 
*** THE DEPARTMENT PUBLISHES EXPLICIT ACCEPTED CERTIFICATES AND SCORE THRESHOLDS FOR INTERNATIONAL APPLICANTS - this is the single most concrete language fact in this record. VADEMECUM FOR INTERNATIONAL STUDENTS (DICMaPI, January 2026), item 5, 'English Language Certificate (B1 minimum)': 'One of the following internationally recognized English certificates is required: IELTS (Academic or General) - overall score corresponding to B1 or above; TOEFL iBT - minimum score: 42; Cambridge English: PET (Preliminary), or higher (FCE, CAE, CPE); Trinity College London: ISE I or higher; Other official certificates recognized as B1 or above under the Common European Framework of Reference (CEFR). Note: If your Bachelor degree was fully taught in English, you may provide an official statement from your university instead of a certificate.' *** 
A TOEFL iBT floor of 42 and Cambridge PET are genuinely B1-level bars, far below the IELTS 6.0-6.5 / TOEFL 79-90 typical of English-taught master's programmes elsewhere. A Medium-of-Instruction (MOI) statement is explicitly accepted in place of a certificate. No recency limit is stated for the ADMISSION certificate (a recency limit does apply to the graduation credit - see Rule 2). 
FOR ITALIAN-EDUCATED APPLICANTS the same B1 gate is met differently. Vademecum LM 2025/26: 'Studenti laureati in Italia: E richiesto il possesso dell'idoneita B1 (es. esame "Inglese 2" in triennale) o il superamento di un test presso il CLA. Solo per A.A. 2025/2026: In alternativa al test/certificazione, e possibile sostenere un breve colloquio non tecnico in lingua inglese con la Commissione Istruttoria.' 
ITALIAN AT B1 IS THE MIRROR RULE, AND IT DOES NOT APPLY HERE. Didactic Regulations Art. 5 imposes Italian B1 only 'Per l'ammissione al curriculum in lingua italiana', i.e. only for Ingegneria di Processo, and only on applicants whose degree was taught in a language other than Italian. Choosing an English curriculum removes any Italian requirement at programme level. 

RULE 2 - PROGRAMME LEVEL, FOR GRADUATION: ENGLISH AT B2, carried as 3 CFU of 'Ulteriori conoscenze linguistiche'. This is NOT an entry barrier; it is a graduation requirement that can be satisfied during the first year, and it applies to ALL students regardless of curriculum. Didactic Regulations Art. 5: 'poiche per conseguire la laurea Magistrale lo studente deve essere in grado di utilizzare fluentemente una lingua dell'Unione europea, oltre alla lingua italiana, il regolamento prevede nel piano di studi un numero adeguato di CFU (almeno 3) per acquisire "Ulteriori conoscenze linguistiche", in particolare nella lingua inglese. Il raggiungimento di tali conoscenze, almeno a livello B2 del QCER, sara attestato con modalita definite dal Centro Linguistico di Ateneo (cla.unina.it). Studenti gia in possesso di attestato di inglese almeno di livello B2 al momento dell'immatricolazione ne richiedono il riconoscimento ai fini delle Ulteriori Conoscenze Linguistiche (3 CFU) con procedure stabilite dal Centro Linguistico di Ateneo.' 
TWO ROUTES, from the Vademecum LM 2025/26. (a) CLA route: 'Il CLA organizzera un corso di 24 ore nel secondo semestre (a partire da marzo 2026). Placement Test: A febbraio 2026 si terra un test. Chi raggiunge il livello B2 e esonerato dal corso e ottiene i crediti. Chi non raggiunge il livello B2 e ammesso al corso. Obblighi: E richiesta una frequenza minima dell'80%. Al termine del corso, il superamento di un esame finale dara diritto ai 3 CFU.' (b) Recognition of an existing certificate, WITH A HARD EXPIRY RULE: 'Certificazioni Esterne: Sono valide le certificazioni rilasciate dagli enti accreditati dal MIUR. Validita: B2: max 2 anni. C1: max 4 anni. C2: max 6 anni.' Procedure: email the certificate to infoingchim@unina.it for a first check, then show the original to the Coordinator together with 'Modello AC' and a copy of your ID. A CLA test/exam already passed counts if taken within the last 2 years. 
*** PLAN AROUND THE 2-YEAR EXPIRY. A B2 certificate is accepted for ADMISSION with no stated age limit, but for the 3 graduation credits a B2 is only valid for 2 years, a C1 for 4 and a C2 for 6. An applicant sitting IELTS/TOEFL now may find it too old to be recognised for the credit later. *** 

RULE 3 - A STALE DEPARTMENTAL PAGE SAYS B2 FOR ADMISSION. DO NOT PANIC, AND DO NOT IGNORE IT EITHER. The department's 'Iscriversi al corso' / 'Enrolling in the course' page states: 'Conoscenza della lingua inglese: per potere essere ammessi al Corso di Laurea Magistrale in Ingegneria Chimica e richiesta una documentata capacita di utilizzare correttamente, in forma scritta e orale, la lingua inglese, almeno pari al livello B2. Tale capacita si concretizza nel riconoscimento di 3 CFU di "ulteriori conoscenze linguistiche", che vanno acquisiti da tutti gli studenti del Corso di Laurea e non soltanto da quelli che scelgono uno dei due Curricula in lingua inglese. Si segnala tuttavia che gli studenti possono acquisire i crediti di "ulteriori conoscenze linguistiche" entro la fine del primo anno accademico.' Read closely, this page is conflating Rule 1 and Rule 2 - and it says in its own next breath that the B2 can be acquired by the end of the first academic year, i.e. it is not a gate. The page is demonstrably out of date (it links the 2023-2024 Regolamento and states a deadline of '1 aprile 2024'). The 2025-2026 Regolamento Didattico and the January 2026 international vademecum both say B1 for admission, and they are the newer and controlling texts. The orientamento.unina.it 2026/2027 profile, meanwhile, states the requirement without any level at all: 'These requirements will include, among other things, the documented ability to use correctly, in written and oral form, the English language (in addition to Italian).' 
NOTE ALSO A TRANSLATION DRIFT ON ORIENTAMENTO ITSELF: the Italian page says 'almeno una lingua dell'Unione Europea oltre l'italiano' (at least one EU language besides Italian), which the English page renders as 'the English language (in addition to Italian)'. 

RULE 4 - UNIVERSITY / MINISTRY LEVEL, FOR NON-EU PRE-ENROLMENT: ITALIAN AT B2, for programmes taught in Italian. THIS IS THE UNRESOLVED POINT AND THE BIGGEST PRACTICAL RISK IN THIS RECORD. international.unina.it, verbatim: '1. If you choose a three-year degree course, magistral degree course or single-cycle magistral degree course in ITALIAN, a B2 level Italian language proficiency is required' - proven either by uploading a CLIQ-system certificate to Universitaly or by sitting an Italian proficiency test whose 'procedures and timing will be communicated by e-mail by the coordinator of the chosen course'. And: '2. If you choose a three-year, five-year or single-cycle degree course in ENGLISH, level B2 Italian language proficiency is not required. Remember that an international certificate attesting to the level of English language skills (IELTS, TOEFL, Cambridge, etc.) is useful for the issue of the visa.' 
WHY THIS IS AMBIGUOUS HERE: the University registers this degree as IT/ENG, not ENG. The International course catalogue lists it as 'Ingegneria Chimica / Chemical Engineering - IT/ENG', unlike the fully English degrees marked '- ENG' (Autonomous Vehicle Engineering, Data Science, Industrial Bioengineering, Transportation Engineering and Mobility). The English exemption in Rule 4 is written for a course 'in ENGLISH'. A candidate who selects this degree on Universitaly is selecting the LM-22 degree, not the curriculum - Universitaly has no field for a curriculum. So it is genuinely unclear whether the Italian B2 requirement is waived for someone who intends to follow Sustainable Engineering or Product Engineering. Note also the drafting asymmetry on unina.it's own page: the sentence exempting English-taught courses lists 'three-year, five-year or single-cycle' and OMITS the two-year magistrale, whereas the sentence imposing Italian B2 explicitly includes 'magistral degree course'. That cuts against the applicant. TREAT ITALIAN B2 AS A LIVE RISK AND SETTLE IT IN WRITING WITH THE PROGRAMME COORDINATOR (Prof. Almerinda Di Benedetto, almerinda.dibenedetto@unina.it / infoingchim@unina.it) BEFORE FILING ON UNIVERSITALY. 

BOTTOM LINE FOR AN INTERNATIONAL APPLICANT: an English B1 certificate (IELTS at B1+, TOEFL iBT 42+, Cambridge PET+, Trinity ISE I+) or an MOI statement is enough to be ADMITTED to either English curriculum - a genuinely low bar. Bring a B2 if you can, because it pre-clears the 3 graduation credits and supports the visa. Do not assume you are exempt from Italian B2 under Rule 4 until the Coordinator confirms it in writing. And remember the thesis MUST be written and defended in English in these curricula, with an Italian abstract attached.
application_deadline_eu:
NO PROGRAMME-SPECIFIC APPLICATION DEADLINE EXISTS FOR EU (AND EU-EQUIVALENT) CANDIDATES, because the programme is open access - there is no call, no application window and no ranking. What binds instead are (A) the admission-evaluation step, (B) the University's enrolment calendar, and (C) the curriculum/study-plan declaration. All university dates below are the official a.y. 2026/2027 dates from the binding 'Guida all'iscrizione Anno accademico 2026-27', the document the programme's own orientamento page points to under 'Application timeline'. 

(A) ADMISSION EVALUATION - NO DEADLINE, DO IT EARLY. Holders of a FOREIGN qualification (EU citizens, or non-EU citizens legally resident in Italy or the EU) should send their documents to the programme, per international.unina.it: 'send your academic documents to the Coordinator of the course you wish to enrol in to find out whether you meet the enrolment requirements'. For this degree the department publishes its own email intake: infoingchim@unina.it (see required_documents). If the applicant has fewer than 40 CFU in the ICHI sectors, or an average below 24/30, a colloquium must be arranged - and note it can only be taken 'dopo l'avvio dell'immatricolazione', i.e. after the enrolment process has been started. If the 54-CFU curricular requirement falls short, the missing credits must be earned via 'corsi singoli' BEFORE enrolment, which can cost a semester or more. Start months ahead of the enrolment window. 

(B) UNIVERSITY ENROLMENT CALENDAR FOR A.Y. 2026/2027 (Guida all'iscrizione 2026-27, 'Date importanti da ricordare per l'anno accademico 2026/27'): 
- 2026-07-16: ordinary immatriculation period OPENS ('16 LUGLIO 2026 - Inizio periodo ordinario immatricolazione'); the first-instalment table specifies 'Dal 16 luglio (immatricolazioni L o iscrizioni I anno LM)', so first-year master's enrolment opens on this date. 
- 2026-09-01: ordinary period opens for enrolment in later years and for transfers and course changes (passaggi e trasferimenti). 
- 2026-11-02: ORDINARY DEADLINE for immatriculation and for enrolment in later years; also the cut-off for ISEEU income data to be pulled from the INPS database, and the deadline for transfers. First instalment due by this date. 
- 2026-11-03: extraordinary (late) enrolment period opens. 
- 2027-01-15: last date to enrol late with a EUR 50 surcharge. 
- 2027-01-16: from this date the late surcharge rises to EUR 110. 
- 2027-03-01: second instalment due (20%). 2027-04-30: third instalment due (20%). 2027-07-16: a further EUR 100 surcharge starts to apply to anyone who has not paid the 2nd or 3rd instalment. 
- 2027-03-31: ABSOLUTE FINAL DEADLINE for first-year enrolment in a two-year master's - 'Le iscrizioni al primo anno dei corsi di laurea magistrali potranno essere effettuate entro il 31 marzo 2027', with the caveat that a Teaching Coordination Commission may require anyone enrolling after 2026-12-31 to first earn between 6 and 12 CFU through single course units (fees for those single course units are refunded if the master's enrolment is completed by 31 March 2027). The department's own Vademecum applies exactly this rule, phrased for the previous year as 'Scadenza perentoria: Il termine ultimo per completare l'iscrizione e il 31 marzo 2026. Nota bene: Oltre questa data, non saranno accettate ulteriori immatricolazioni.' - so for a.y. 2026/2027 read 31 March 2027. 
NOTE A CONFLICT ON ORIENTAMENTO: the orientamento.unina.it 'Application timeline' section states 'Enrolment for the first year normally takes place between 1 September and 31 December of each year, while enrolment for subsequent years normally takes place between 1 September and 31 October.' Those dates do not match the 2026/27 Guida (16 July - 2 November ordinary, late to 15 January 2027, absolute 31 March 2027). USE THE GUIDA. 

(C) THE PROGRAMME-LEVEL DEADLINE THAT DECIDES YOUR CURRICULUM. The curriculum is selected by the student, not assigned. Vademecum LM 2025/26: 'La scelta deve essere effettuata al momento dell'immatricolazione tramite il portale Segrepass', with the decision path spelled out as 'a) Valutazione ... b) Scelta: Selezione del curriculum su Segrepass durante la procedura di immatricolazione. c) Adempimento: Completamento della domanda entro il 31 marzo [2026].' The programme's Study Plan page states it differently: 'Gli studenti immatricolati sono tenuti a presentare entro il 31 ottobre un piano di studi per indicare sia la scelta tra uno dei tre curricula del Corso di Laurea Magistrale sia quella degli insegnamenti a scelta autonoma.' See uncertainty_notes - safest reading is to select the English curriculum on Segrepass at immatriculation AND confirm it in the study plan by 31 October. 
STUDY-PLAN WINDOWS (Vademecum LM 2025/26, section 9): first-year students are advised to submit within a month of immatriculation and in any case not later than 31 March; students in later years have 1 September - 31 October. No study plan is needed if the 18 free-choice CFU are covered entirely by the courses pre-loaded on Segrepass (excluding Biomateriali and Ingegneria Sanitaria Ambientale). A study plan IS needed to take non-pre-loaded electives, to join a Minor, or if 'Sicurezza dei Processi Chimici' was already passed during the bachelor. Submission is by email to infoingchim@unina.it, file named PS_Matricola_Cognome_Nome.pdf, and 'E indispensabile allegare il certificato storico degli esami della laurea triennale. In assenza di questo documento, la richiesta non sara presa in esame.' 

PROCEDURE: Italian and EU students enrol online through SegrePass (www.segrepass.unina.it). Foreign citizens complete enrolment through the competent Secretary's office - here the Segreteria Studenti Ingegneria of the SPSB, Piazzale Tecchio 80 (ing. Flavio Ciccarelli, segreing@unina.it). 

[uncertain] The Guida itself warns 'le date di scadenza possono essere soggette a variazioni'. The programme publishes no EU-applicant admission timetable, so the practical lead time for a committee evaluation of a foreign transcript is not documented; and the department's Vademecum dates are the 2025/26 ones, awaiting a 2026/27 reissue.
application_deadline_non_eu:
FOR NON-EU CANDIDATES RESIDING ABROAD THERE IS A HARD, MINISTRY-DRIVEN DATE AND IT IS EARLY: 15 JUNE 2026. 

- 2026-06-15: PRE-ENROLMENT APPLICATION DEADLINE on the UNIVERSITALY portal, naming the University of Naples Federico II and this degree programme. international.unina.it, verbatim: 'JUNE - 15 - 2026 - Pre-enrolment application deadline to University of Naples Federico II. After this date no programme changes are permitted. After this date pre-enrolment is allowed to the programmes with restricted access only.' THIS IS THE OPERATIVE DEADLINE FOR THIS PROGRAMME: because Ingegneria Chimica is OPEN access (not restricted access), non-EU pre-enrolment closes on 15 June 2026 and does NOT reopen. Miss it and the a.y. 2026/2027 intake is closed to you. This is the single most important date in this record for a non-EU applicant - it falls a full month BEFORE the university's own enrolment window even opens on 16 July 2026. 
- 2026-11-30: deadline for lodging the study-visa application at Italian Embassies/Consulates - 'NOVEMBER - 30 - 2026 - Deadline for submitting the Visa Application at Iyalian [sic] Embassies /Consulates.' 
- Then the University's ordinary enrolment calendar still applies on arrival (ordinary period to 2026-11-02, late enrolment to 2027-01-15 with EUR 50 and from 2027-01-16 with EUR 110, absolute final date for first-year LM enrolment 2027-03-31). 

HOW THE PIPELINE WORKS. Pre-enrolment is compulsory and separate from enrolment: international.unina.it, 'The university pre-enrolment application is the first step to be taken by a candidate in order to apply for a visa for study purposes at an Italian diplomatic representation. The "university pre-enrolment" procedure is different and distinct from that of "enrolment".' It is done exclusively through the Universitaly portal (https://www.universitaly.it/studenti-stranieri), naming Federico II, the degree programme, and the Embassy/Consulate where the visa will be requested. 
CRITICAL WARNINGS PUBLISHED BY THE UNIVERSITY: 'Be aware that pre-enrolment alone does not grant admission to degree programmes. In order to matriculate you also need to take and pass the verifications of the entry requirements and the admission procedures set for the degree programme of your interest.' And: 'Important! The University of Naples Federico II does not issue admission letters for obtaining a visa.' The visa therefore rests on the VALIDATED Universitaly pre-enrolment summary, not on a letter from the department. 
SEQUENCING PROBLEM SPECIFIC TO THIS PROGRAMME - READ THIS. The department's subject colloquium 'potra essere sostenuto solo dopo l'avvio dell'immatricolazione' (can only be taken after the enrolment process has begun), and missing curricular credits must be made up through 'corsi singoli' BEFORE enrolment. Both of those sit AFTER, or long before, the 15 June Universitaly cut-off. A non-EU applicant with fewer than 40 CFU in the ICHI sectors, or a bachelor average below 24/30, or a curricular shortfall against the 54-CFU grid, should therefore open the conversation with infoingchim@unina.it MANY MONTHS before 15 June 2026 and get the sequence confirmed in writing. 
VISA REQUIREMENTS the Embassy will check (international.unina.it): means of subsistence, funds for repatriation, suitable accommodation in Italy, and adequate medical/hospitalisation insurance valid in Italy. A type 'D' study visa is issued, and only for the year of enrolment. After arrival, apply for a residence permit. 
NON-EU APPLICANTS ALREADY LEGALLY RESIDENT IN ITALY OR THE EU ARE NOT ON THIS TIMETABLE: 'Non-European candidates, wherever they reside and regularly residing in Italy or in a European Union country, have unrestricted access to university courses if they hold a qualification corresponding to the required Italian qualification ... you may present your academic documents directly to the Coordinator of the Course in which you wish to enrol. You will therefore not need to pre-register on the Universitaly Portal.' They follow the EU calendar in application_deadline_eu. 

[uncertain] The exact subsistence and insurance figures for the 2026/2027 visa round were not re-verified from the ministerial circular during this research (the circular is hosted on universitaly-private.cineca.it, outside unina.it, and was not consulted per the unina.it-only scope of this brief). Check them with the Embassy.
required_documents:
THIS PROGRAMME PUBLISHES AN UNUSUALLY CLEAR, SELF-CONTAINED CHECKLIST FOR INTERNATIONAL APPLICANTS - use it as the primary list. Three further lists apply at later stages. 

(1) *** DEPARTMENT'S INTERNATIONAL-APPLICANT CHECKLIST (the operative first step). *** 'VADEMECUM FOR INTERNATIONAL STUDENTS - Application to the MSc in Chemical Engineering - University of Naples Federico II' (DICMaPI, PDF uploaded January 2026, signed by Prof. Almerinda Di Benedetto): 
HOW TO SEND IT: 'Send your application by email to: infoingchim@unina.it - Subject: Application - MSc Chemical Engineering [Your Full Name]'. 
'Attach the following documents in PDF format: 1. Passport (valid); 2. Curriculum Vitae (CV); 3. Bachelor's Degree Diploma; 4. Transcript of Records (with courses and grades); 5. English Language Certificate (B1 minimum).' 
Accepted English certificates and thresholds: IELTS (Academic or General) at B1 or above; TOEFL iBT minimum 42; Cambridge English PET (Preliminary) or higher (FCE, CAE, CPE); Trinity College London ISE I or higher; or any other official certificate recognised as B1+ under the CEFR. Alternative: 'If your Bachelor degree was fully taught in English, you may provide an official statement from your university instead of a certificate.' 
TRANSLATION RULE: 'All documents must be in English or accompanied by a certified English translation.' 
WHAT HAPPENS NEXT: 'After the initial check, you may be contacted for an interview or further steps.' 
NOTE WHAT IS NOT ASKED FOR: no motivation letter, no reference letters, no research proposal, no application fee, no online form - it is a plain email submission. Because the curricular check is CFU-by-SSD (see academic_requirements), make sure the transcript shows credit values, and be ready to supply syllabi so the committee can map your courses onto the ICHI-01/B, ICHI-02/A, ICHI-01/C and ICHI-02/B sectors. 

(2) FOR NON-EU PRE-ENROLMENT / THE VISA (Universitaly + Embassy). international.unina.it: take to the Italian Embassy 'the summary of the pre-enrolment application submitted through Universitaly and validated by the University of Naples Federico II; any language competence certificates; the documents required for the visa application, including a health insurance policy where applicable; the required documents if you hold a foreign qualification.' Plus evidence of subsistence, repatriation funds or a return ticket, accommodation in Italy, and medical insurance valid in Italy. 

(3) FOR ENROLMENT (matriculation) - international.unina.it, 'Documents required for enrolment': copy of passport; application form; 1 passport photo; tax code (codice fiscale); residence permit (or proof of having applied for it); and 'Declaration of value issued by the Italian Embassy in the country where the degree was obtained or certificate of validity issued by ENIC-NARIC centres' (CIMEA, https://www.cimea.it/EN/). The University also reserves the right to require 'eventual translations, legalisations, Diploma Supplement, certificates of examinations'. Italian/EU students enrol through SegrePass; non-EU students complete enrolment through the Segreteria Studenti Ingegneria at Piazzale Tecchio 80. 

(4) PROGRAMME-SPECIFIC ITEMS AFTER ENROLMENT: 
- CURRICULUM SELECTION on Segrepass during immatriculation (Sustainable Engineering or Product Engineering) - without it you are not in an English curriculum. 
- STUDY PLAN, if you want non-pre-loaded electives, a Minor, or you already passed 'Sicurezza dei Processi Chimici' in your bachelor: download the form from the programme site, save as PS_Matricola_Cognome_Nome.pdf, email to infoingchim@unina.it, and MANDATORILY attach the full transcript of the bachelor ('E indispensabile allegare il certificato storico degli esami della laurea triennale. In assenza di questo documento, la richiesta non sara presa in esame.'). 
- ENGLISH B2 CERTIFICATE + 'Modello AC' to infoingchim@unina.it, to have the 3 CFU of 'Ulteriori conoscenze linguistiche' recognised (subject to the 2-year / 4-year / 6-year validity limits for B2 / C1 / C2); the original must later be shown to the Coordinator with a copy of your ID. Otherwise sit the CLA placement test or take the CLA 24-hour B2 course. 
- CURRICULAR-INTEGRATION PAPERWORK where the committee prescribes it: the single-course-unit (corsi singoli) enrolment, http://www.unina.it/-/5601348-iscrizione-ai-corsi-singoli . 

[uncertain] The international vademecum does not state a submission deadline of its own, does not say how long the evaluation takes, and does not say whether a Letter of Acceptance is issued - which matters because international.unina.it states flatly that the University 'does not issue admission letters for obtaining a visa'. Nor does it state whether legalisation / declaration of value is needed at the screening stage or only at enrolment.
tuition_or_fees_link:
OFFICIAL LINKS: fees and enrolment hub https://www.unina.it/didattica/sportello-studenti/guide-dello-studente (this is the exact URL the programme's orientamento page cites under 'Application timeline') | fees section https://www.unina.it/it/didattica/iscrizioni-e-tasse | the binding 2026/27 document 'Guida all'iscrizione Anno accademico 2026-27' at https://www.unina.it/documents/d/guest/guida_studente_rapida_26-27_10-7-2026 | official fee simulator http://calcolatrice.unina.it | international-student summary https://www.international.unina.it/education/admission-regulation/ | enrolment portal https://www.segrepass.unina.it . The programme's own website publishes no fee page of its own. 

SHORT ANSWER FOR AN INTERNATIONAL APPLICANT: this degree is close to free. Non-EU citizens are TOTALLY EXEMPT from the tuition contribution and pay only the regional right-to-study tax plus a EUR 16 stamp; EU non-Italian citizens pay a flat EUR 200 contribution plus the regional tax and stamp. Realistic 2026/27 totals with a household resident abroad: about EUR 167/year for a non-EU student and about EUR 367/year for an EU non-Italian student. 

THE BINDING RULES (Guida all'iscrizione 2026-27, section 5 'Esoneri'):

Any downstream listing built from this record must offer the applicant a choice between two English tracks, not one, and they are substantively different in content (bio/sustainability/process design vs. soft matter/rheology/product formulation). 

2. DIPLOMA NAME vs CURRICULUM NAME - THE OTHER CENTRAL POINT OF THIS RECORD. The qualification awarded is the Italian degree 'Ingegneria Chimica' (class LM-22). 'Chemical Engineering' is the University's own official English rendering of that same degree (Didactic Regulations Art. 1: 'nome del corso in inglese: Chemical Engineering'), and 'Sustainable Engineering' / 'Product Engineering' are curricula inside it, not degree titles. [uncertain] I found NO unina.it text stating whether the curriculum name is printed on the diploma or on the Diploma Supplement. The only Diploma Supplement statement published for this programme concerns the optional Minor: orientamento.unina.it says that at the end of a Minor 'the student obtains a specific mention reported in the Diploma Supplement'. That a Minor is explicitly said to appear on the Diploma Supplement, while nothing equivalent is said about the curriculum, is suggestive but not conclusive. Italian practice is normally that the curriculum appears on the Diploma Supplement and the transcript rather than on the diploma parchment, but that is inference, not a sourced fact for this programme. Anyone relying on the English-language identity of this qualification abroad should assume the certificate reads 'Ingegneria Chimica'. 

3. ACADEMIC-YEAR MISMATCH BETWEEN UNIVERSITY AND PROGRAMME DOCUMENTS. The orientamento profile is marked 'Update a.a. 2026/2027' and the university fee/calendar documents are 2026/27, but the newest Didactic Regulations published for this degree are 'in vigore a partire dall'a.a. 2025-2026' and the newest student guide is the 'Vademecum LM 2025/26' (uploaded April 2026); the orientamento study-plan download is itself labelled 'Study plan 2025/2026'. No 2026-2027 Regolamento Didattico was found, and probe URLs following the department's own file-naming pattern returned the site's HTML shell rather than a PDF. The programme-level rules in this record (54 CFU, M >= 24, B1, curriculum choice) should be re-checked when a 2026-2027 Regolamento appears. Note one date in this record is explicitly a 2025/26 date carried forward by analogy: the Vademecum's 'termine ultimo ... 31 marzo 2026' corresponds to the Guida's 31 March 2027 for a.y. 2026/27. 

4. *** B1 vs B2 ENGLISH - A DIRECT CONTRADICTION BETWEEN TWO UNINA.IT PAGES, AND IT MATTERS. *** The 2025-2026 Didactic Regulations (Art. 5) and the January 2026 international vademecum both say B1 English for ADMISSION to the English curricula, with B2 required only to GRADUATE (3 CFU, obtainable during the first year). The department's 'Iscriversi al corso' / 'Enrolling in the course' page says B2 is required 'per potere essere ammessi'. That page is demonstrably stale - it links the 2023-2024 Regolamento, states a deadline of '1 aprile 2024', and describes a personal-preparation formula using both average M and study duration D that the current Regolamento has replaced. It also contradicts itself by adding that the credits may be acquired 'entro la fine del primo anno accademico'. My reading: B1 is the real admission bar, B2 is the graduation bar. But because the stale page is still live on the department's own site, an applicant with only B1 should carry the international vademecum's text when corresponding with the office, and confirm in writing. 

5. THE ITALIAN B2 QUESTION FOR NON-EU APPLICANTS IS GENUINELY UNRESOLVED, AND IT IS THE BIGGEST PRACTICAL RISK IN THIS RECORD. The University waives Italian B2 for courses 'in ENGLISH' but registers this degree as IT/ENG in its own International course catalogue, and Universitaly pre-enrolment is filed against the DEGREE, which has no curriculum field. The waiver sentence on international.unina.it also lists 'three-year, five-year or single-cycle' and omits the two-year magistrale, while the sentence imposing Italian B2 explicitly names 'magistral degree course'. Get this confirmed in writing by the Coordinator before filing on Universitaly. This is the same structural ambiguity that affects the other IT/ENG Federico II master's degrees. 

6. CURRICULUM-DECLARATION TIMING - TWO DIFFERENT ANSWERS ON THE DEPARTMENT'S OWN SITE. The Vademecum LM 2025/26 says the curriculum is chosen 'al momento dell'immatricolazione tramite il portale Segrepass'. The programme's Study Plan page says students must submit a study plan by 31 October indicating 'sia la scelta tra uno dei tre curricula ... sia quella degli insegnamenti a scelta autonoma'. These may describe a selection made at enrolment and then confirmed in the study plan, but no source says so. Safest course: select the English curriculum on Segrepass at immatriculation AND confirm it in the study plan by 31 October.

'Il colloquio potra essere sostenuto solo dopo l'avvio dell'immatricolazione', and the Coordinator arranges the date individually. Meanwhile non-EU pre-enrolment on Universitaly closes 15 June 2026, and the university's enrolment window does not open until 16 July 2026. Nothing states whether the colloquium can be held remotely, in what language it is conducted for a candidate entering an English curriculum, whether there is a pass mark, or how many attempts are allowed.

For a foreign applicant short on the 18-CFU ICHI block or any of the other three blocks, this can mean a lost year. The published elective list mixes English and Italian titles. This is stated as a fact on the department's site, not as a warning, and it is the most likely way for a non-Italian-speaking student to end up in an Italian-taught classroom.
